verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of isolating non-production environments (e.g. staging apps or orgs) from production services, such as separate private networks or per-environment network policies. The only related material is Sprite egress policies and per-Sprite service access grants for agent sandboxes. That is an adjacent control for a different feature, not environment-level isolation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
